# São Tomé and Príncipe — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of São Tomé and Príncipe?", "São Tomé"),
    ("What currency does São Tomé and Príncipe use?", "Dobra"),
    ("What is capital?", "São Tomé"),
    ("What is currency?", "Dobra (STN)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+239"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".st"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "Africa"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
